name: Binary Greedy Meshing with Packed Quads
definition: A voxel meshing technique that treats the Signed Distance Field (SDF) as solid/empty and merges co-planar visible faces into maximal axis-aligned quads using bitwise operations, drawn instanced from an 8-byte packed record.
summary: Binary Greedy Meshing with Packed Quads is a surface extraction algorithm that uses bitwise operations on binary planes to efficiently merge voxel faces into maximal quads, significantly reducing geometry compared to traditional methods.
